items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: The rhythm section of the Erskine Hawkins band had been off and they were working there.

ctx.x: The rhythm section of the Erskine Hawkins band had been off and they were working there. Lowell Morgan [Staufield] who is still around, and the bass player's name, Lee and the drummer, and Erskine has a gig and so they have to come back and they need a replacement so Fathead Lawrence have to look that up too, he's a hell of a baritone, played without a strap.
Must have had some strong hands.
